name: Vasundhara Rasayans Limited
about: Vasundhara Rasayans Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of antacids therapeutic category of active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) in India. It offers antacid API, such as aluminum hydroxide gel, magnesium hydroxide, magaldrate, magnesium trisilicate, magnesium silicate, and aluminum phosphate. The company also provides aluminum hydroxide gel with low heavy lead content for lake color; aluminum hydroxide amorphous, aluminum sulphate, and poly aluminum chloride for water treatment and aluminum salts applications; and organic API intermediate and dyes intermediate. In addition, it offers technical backup support services. The company serves pharmaceutical, food, and chemical industries. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Hyderabad, India. Vasundhara Rasayans Limited operates as a subsidiary of P&J Cretechem Private Limited.
